provenance.chassis: datasheet (Dimensions WxDxH 43.84 x 53.6 x 4.35 cm; Weight 10 kg)
provenance.entity-and-interfaces: read from the live unit (ArcOS S8.5.1A, netlab-leaf1) via 'show components | display json' and 'show interface brief'. Chassis serial, MAC and every per-transceiver serial are redacted from the committed dump
provenance.faceplate-structure: described by the owner from the unit - top two SFP rows are 2x4 ganged belly-to-belly assemblies, bottom row is 1x2 ganged in the same orientation as row 2. Visible seams measure every 2 columns (~33mm), so the drawn column geometry is unchanged by that grouping; the 2x4 spans two visual pairs. Link/activity arrows sit in the belly-to-belly gap of rows 1-2, three per column (up = row 1, down = row 2, right-hand down = row 3), and the port numbers appear ONCE per column between rows 2 and 3 as N-up / N+1-down / N+2-down - no other SFP row carries numbers
provenance.mgmt-block: owner - the two 10G ports are a 1x2 belly-to-belly gang with arrow LEDs between them and their label below the lower one, USB-A beneath that; the RJ45 pair is top-to-top (latches facing away from each other, not toward) with a USB-C below and the pull-out tab under that stack. The 10G pair is ports 57/58. The SFP-to-QSFP gap is ~21mm, just over one QSFP port width
provenance.port-arrangement: 3 rows x 16 columns confirmed on the physical unit by the owner. The datasheet panel figure is a marketing render whose column widths do not reconcile - 24 columns would need 342mm and leave no room for the mgmt block
provenance.port-count-note: ArcOS presents swp1-swp56 only. The faceplate labels the 10G management pair 57/58, but they are not ASIC switch ports - no swp57/58 exists
provenance.port-pitch: standard - SFP columns on the SFF-8433 basic 14.25, QSFP on the 19.0 measured from TE 2322551-4. The datasheet figure measures 14.45, the same ~1.4 percent scale error the S9510 HIG figure carried, so the standards are used rather than the figure
provenance.port-row-pitch: estimated (~14.5-15.0 to fit three rows in the 43.5mm face; the belly-to-belly reference from TE 2007562-6 is 15.0) - verify with calipers
provenance.psu-fan-reuse: the AC PSU FRU part numbers (F0TZZ5654019A / F0TZZ5654020A) are identical to the AS7726-32X, so common/psu-ac-650 is the same physical module
provenance.qsfp-structure: owner + IMG_2141 - belly-to-belly pairs labelled between the two ports of a column. The columns form two groups of two with roughly twice the separation between groups. Above the block each column carries two rows of four lane LEDs (L1-L4), the upper row belonging to the upper port, with the port number at the left of each row - the photo shows this directly
provenance.rear-layout: datasheet figure (PSU2 | 6 fans | PSU1, grounding point each end), geometry reused from the AS7726-32X which shares this chassis width
provenance.status-led-labels: drawing + photo - DIAG, LOC, PS1, PS2 and FAN are printed to the LEFT of their lamps and level with them, not beneath them: the datasheet page-2 System LEDs callout and IMG_2141 agree, and the same layout is visible on the S9510-28DC lamp stack. Right-anchored 1.3mm clear of the lamp column at x 9.2, with each baseline on its lamp centre. They were left-anchored at 12.5 under the lamps, which put DIAG into port-1
provenance.top-bottom-sides: extrapolated from the AS7726-32X, which shares this chassis line and its width and height, restretched to the 536mm depth. Top grooves and the centre access plate are from IMG_2129; the bottom labels from IMG_2130. Side screw and vent positions are NOT measured - reshoot on a bench to confirm
